title: Complete-information ultimatum with outside option
information: Both players know V and u. Assume 0 <= u < V.
timing: Proposer offers x in [0,V]; responder chooses accept or reject.
equilibrium_argument: Responder accepts iff x>=u. If u<V, proposer makes the smallest accepted offer, x*=u. Independently verify the argument and boundary conditions for real work.

comparative_statics.hypothesis_text: Increasing the outside option raises the offered concession.
comparative_statics.interpretation: A higher outside option raises the smallest accepted offer one-for-one.
